title: Add trigger endpoint for Optimize quality gating (config diff + baseline)
author: Olivia Grant
description: Context: Optimize needs a first-class way to run offline evals against a proposed serving config change (batching/caching/quantization profile) before allowing apply/rollout. This PR adds a new API endpoint and job plumbing in eval-harness to accept a config diff + baseline reference, execute the requested gate tier against selected prompt sets, and return structured metrics plus artifact pointers suitable for Console/Optimize consumption. Endpoint: POST /api/v1/gates/trigger (auth: service-to-service token; scoped to optimize-gating). Request (JSON): gate_tier ("smoke"|"full"), model_id, baseline (baseline_model_version + baseline_runtime_config_ref), proposed (runtime_config_diff, optional proposed_model_version), prompt_sets (ids), sample_count (optional; defaults per tier), run_metadata (route_id, account_id, region, commit_sha, idempotency_key). Validation: limits request payload size, rejects unknown diff keys, enforces that baseline ref is immutable (no "latest"), and checks prompt set ids exist and are enabled for gating. Execution: enqueues a GateRun job to the existing eval runner queue, pins model + runtime settings for the duration of the run, and writes an immutable run record with normalized inputs for audit/debug. Response: 202 Accepted with gate_run_id + status_url + estimated_duration_s; once complete, GET /api/v1/gates/runs/{id} returns status, summary metrics (per prompt set and overall), and artifact pointers (artifact_store_uri + optional signed_url when allowed), including: raw per-example outputs, rubric/score breakdowns, and a compact "comparison.json" (baseline vs proposed deltas). Artifacts: stored under artifact_store_uri prefix gates/{gate_run_id}/..., with retention aligned to existing eval artifact policy; Optimize can deep-link using gate_run_id. Observability: emits gate_trigger_requests_total and gate_run_enqueue_latency_ms (tags: gate_tier, model_id, region, caller=optimize) and attaches trace/span attributes for correlation from Optimize -> eval-harness. Tests: adds contract tests for request validation + schema stability, a fake runner integration test that asserts correct pinning of baseline/proposed configs, and golden JSON snapshots for the run detail response. Notes: This PR does not implement flake scoring/rerun aggregation (tracked in pr-418); response schema includes an optional flake_score field but it is not populated yet. Rollout: endpoint is behind feature flag OPTIMIZE_GATING_TRIGGER_API and requires allowlisted client identity; we can safely deploy without enabling any callers.

tests: contract + snapshot tests for Optimize gating responses

review_conversation: Jonas Weber: Can we ensure baseline is immutable? We should reject 'latest' and require an explicit version/ref so Optimize can't accidentally compare against a moving target.
Olivia Grant (author): Added baseline_runtime_config_ref validation + explicit version requirement; request now rejects 'latest' and any ref without a content hash.
Selene Huang: Please include per-prompt-set summary in the run detail response; Optimize needs to surface which suite failed, not just overall.
Olivia Grant (author): Updated response schema to include prompt_set_results[] with aggregate metrics + artifact pointer per suite; added snapshot tests.
Connor O'Brien: CI note—these tests will be run in CPU-only jobs. Make sure the fake runner path is deterministic and doesn't require GPU.
Olivia Grant (author): Switched integration test to FakeExecutor; runner job only asserts config pinning + manifest write, no model execution.
Ethan Park: Any reason this isn't idempotent? Optimize will retry on 5xx; we should support idempotency_key to avoid duplicate runs.
Olivia Grant (author): Added idempotency_key to request; service now dedupes within 24h on (caller, idempotency_key) and returns existing gate_run_id.
Jonas Weber: Approving with the caveat that flake_score is optional and must remain nullable until pr-418 lands.
Selene Huang: LGTM after the per-suite summary; thanks.
release_notes: Internal: eval-harness now exposes /api/v1/gates/trigger and /api/v1/gates/runs/{id} for Optimize quality gating, returning structured metrics and artifact pointers. Endpoint is feature-flagged and allowlisted.
